update.clogs:
Base Version: 451.0.0.53.80

Added: Anti-Disappearing Messages — Prevents messages from automatically disappearing from your chats, even after the timer expires. (Premium)

Added: Anti-Ban Protection — Removed all the Mod detections completely from InstaPrime App.

Added: Download All Stories at Once — download multiple stories in a single tap instead of downloading them one by one.

Added: Long-Press Search to Open Profile — Copy an Instagram username or profile URL → Long-press the Search tab → InstaPrime instantly opens the profile. Supports username with or without @.

Added: Auto Mark as Seen for specific users in DMs — No need to manually mark DMs as seen.

Added: Ability to view Last Seen status with the exact date and time in DMs.

Added: Anti-Delete Messages. (Realtime)

Added: Mark as Seen on Reaction.

Added: Quick Settings Shortcut — Added a home screen shortcut to access InstaPrime Settings quickly.

Added: Reel Download icon directly in the reels section for quicker and easier access.

Added: Download and InstaPrime Options icons directly in the feed for quicker and easier access.

Added: Enable or disable the Download and InstaPrime Options icons directly in the feed.

Added: Saved Profiles.

Added: Filter Stories (Based on types).

Fixed: View Blocked Profiles Secretly crashes.

Fixed: Audio to Voice Note issue causing robotic or distorted voice output.

Fixed: Carousel Download Issues.

Fixed: Chat Fonts issues (DMs).

Fixed: Some random crashes.

Fixed: Hide Chats Issues.

Fixed: Anti-View Once. (Now works 100% accurately)

Fixed: Story Download issues.

Fixed: Instant Download Quality issues — Instant Download with Highest Quality.

Fixed: Flag names issues.

Improved: Filter Notifications (Now works 100% accurately)

Removed: All the experimental options.

Removed: Built-in backup file for better experience.
